title: TinyFeeder: hardware-aware NAS, mixed-precision QAT and multi-teacher distillation for fish feeding-intensity recognition on edge devices (code)
description: Reference implementation of the TinyFeeder pipeline (hardware-aware NAS with NSGA-II and a gradient-boosted latency predictor, mixed-precision INT8/FP16 quantization-aware training, multi-teacher knowledge distillation, gated audio-visual fusion, ONNX/TensorRT/TFLite deployment) accompanying the Scientific Reports article 'Tiny Feeder: Hardware-Aware Neural Architecture Search for Ultra-Lightweight Fish Feeding Intensity Recognition on Edge Devices'. Includes a synthetic AV-FFIA-like data generator and an end-to-end demonstration run on synthetic data; the farm recordings used in the article are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.
